like the day his father died, … Like the day his teacher died,
like the day his father died, referring to the father of the individual making the vow, as there is a custom to fast on the anniversary of a parent’s death, or: Like the day his teacher died,
Like the day I saw Jerusalem in its … destruction.
Like the day I saw Jerusalem in its state of destruction.

And although there were many permitted Sundays … and … the tanna teaches

And although there were many permitted Sundays in the interim, nevertheless, when he said he would not eat meat or drink wine like the day of the week on which his father died, his intention was to the particular Sunday when his father died, when he had vowed to abstain from meat and wine, and therefore the tanna teaches
Learn from this that he associates … the original
Learn from this that he associates the object of his vow with the original
